metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: A photorealistic food photography shot of thick olive oil being drizzled from a bottle onto a glass bowl of mixed greens. The oil forms continuous, viscous ribbons that correctly cling to leaf surfaces and pool at the bowl base, bright lighting, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: The oil viscosity, adhesion to leaves, and pooling behavior accurately reflect real fluid dynamics.
